participants.label: Hub page
participants.note: The passkey belongs to the hub's domain, so the confirmation runs on the hub page.

participants.label: Passkey
participants.note: Touch ID, a phone, or a security key. The private key never leaves it.

participants.label: Hub
participants.note: Carries challenges, signed answers and messages between the browser and the machine. It cannot open the machine: it has no private key.

participants.label: Machine
participants.note: Holds the pinned passkey public key, issues challenges, verifies signatures and keeps the 1-hour window.

participants.label: Flowpad Assistant
participants.note: The same chat as the floating Flowpad Assistant window (ui/src/components/floating-chat/AssistantChat.tsx:197).

messages.label: Connect websocket
messages.note: Part 1 — connected. The machine dials out and stays connected (flow_sdk/cloud_client/ws_client.py:88). Everything below that touches the machine travels on this socket; nothing calls into the machine over HTTP.

messages.label: Enable admin channel
messages.note: Part 2 — pair, once, on the machine itself (Preferences, This machine). Default off.

messages.label: Get owner's passkey public keys
messages.note: The passkey itself is created once on the hub page (navigator.credentials.create()); only its public key is ever shared.

messages.label: Pin public keys
messages.note: The machine shows each key's name and fingerprint for the person to confirm, then stores them. A passkey added later is not trusted until it is pinned here or approved inside an open window.

messages.label: challenge
messages.note: Random, single use, 5 minutes, made by the machine. Refused here when admin channel is off.

messages.label: navigator.credentials.get()
messages.note: The user confirms with fingerprint, face or PIN.

messages.label: Verify, open for 1 hour
messages.note: Checks the signature against a pinned public key, that the challenge is its own, the hub origin, user verification and the sign count. Then keeps open_until = now + 1 hour. Fixed window, not sliding.

messages.label: open until
messages.note: The page shows the time left and Lock now.

messages.label: Check window is open
messages.note: Admin channel on, open_until not passed, sender is the pinned owner.

messages.label: Run turn
messages.note: Recorded as an ordinary conversation on channel admin; one assistant chat per admin conversation.

messages.label: admin message
messages.note: Part 5 — after the hour, or after Lock now.

messages.label: refused: confirm again
messages.note: The page opens the passkey dialog, repeats part 3, then sends the message again.
